turns.question: On which day of the week were the most orders placed between 17 August and 27 September 2026, and how many orders were placed on that weekday in total?
turns.answer: No single weekday stands out: each of the seven weekdays had 24 orders (orders placed, cancelled included) between 17 August and 27 September 2026, so the figure is a tie at 24 per weekday. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
